candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. Im get cough or e dey breathe with difficulty. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. I count im breathing for one minute. Pikin calm when I check am. Im no dey convulse now. Dem never see convulsion for am before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Im cough don last for 3 days. E no get chest indrawing. Pulse oximeter no dey available. E get recurrent wheeze and I hear wheezing. E respiratory rate na 35. E no get stridor when e calm.
